notes.raw:
\*Data above 350 K estimated. 
Phase changes: 598 K, β - γ transition point of Fe $_{0.877}$ S; ΔH° = 0.095 kcal/mol. 
1043 K, Curie temperature of Fe; $\Delta H^{\delta} = 0$ kcal/mol. 
1185 K, $\alpha - \gamma$ transition point of Fe; $\Delta H^{\circ} = 0.215 \mathrm{kcal} / \mathrm{mol}$ . 
1667 K, Y - δ transition point of Fe; $\Delta H^{\circ} = 0.200$ kcal/mol. 
Heat capacity (cal/mol·K) and enthalpy (kcal/mol) equations: 
298.15-598 K: $Cp^{0} = 7.510 + 14.798 \times 10^{-3} T$ 
$H^{\circ}-H_{298}^{\circ}=7.510\times10^{-3}T+7.399\times10^{-6}T^{2}-2.897$ 
598-1800 K: $Cp^{\circ} = -1.709 + 11.746 \times 10^{-3} T + 30.734 \times 10^{5} T^{-2}$ 
$H^{\circ}-H_{298}^{\circ}=-1.709\times10^{-9}T+5.873\times10^{-6}T^{2}-30.734\times10^{2}T^{-1}+8.396$ 
Reaction equations (kcal/mol): 
298.15-598 K: $\Delta \mathrm{Hr}^{\circ} = -42.336 + 3.532 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T} + 1.915 \times 10^{-6} \mathrm{T}^{2} + 166.245 \mathrm{T}^{-1}$ 
$\Delta \mathrm{Gr}^{\circ} = -42.336 - 3.532 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T} \ln \mathrm{T} - 1.915 \times 10^{-6} \mathrm{T}^{2} + 83.122 \mathrm{T}^{-1} + 44.175 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T}$ 
598-1043 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -31.043 - 5.687 \times 10^{-3} T + 0.389 \times 10^{-6} T^{2} - 2907.156 T^{-1}$ 
$\Delta \mathrm{Gr}^{\circ} = -31.043 + 5.687 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T} \ln \mathrm{T} - 0.389 \times 10^{-6} \mathrm{T}^{2} - 1453.578 \mathrm{T}^{-1} - 30.268 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T}$ 
1043-1185 K: $\Delta \mathrm{Hr}^{\circ} = -10.380 - 44.258 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T} + 18.552 \times 10^{-6} \mathrm{T}^{2} - 3107.550 \mathrm{T}^{-1}$ 
$\Delta \mathrm{Gr}^{\circ} = -10.380 + 44.258 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T} \ln \mathrm{T} - 18.552 \times 10^{-6} \mathrm{T}^{2} - 1553.775 \mathrm{T}^{-1} - 299.107 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T}$ 
1185-1667 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -31.089 - 10.708 \times 10^{-3} T + 4.791 \times 10^{-6} T^{2} - 3003.187 T^{-1}$ 
$\Delta \mathrm{Gr}^{\circ} = -31.089 + 10.708 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T} \ln \mathrm{T} - 4.791 \times 10^{-6} \mathrm{T}^{2} - 1501.594 \mathrm{T}^{-1} - 60.527 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T}$ 
1667-1800 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -103.788 + 31.823 \times 10^{-3} T - 3.655 \times 10^{-6} T^{2} + 38829.012 T^{-1}$ 
$\Delta \mathrm{Gr}^{\circ} = -103.788 - 31.823 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T} \ln \mathrm{T} + 3.655 \times 10^{-6} \mathrm{T}^{2} + 19414.506 \mathrm{T}^{-1} + 277.011 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T}$ 
Source: Data from Chase (17) who estimated all above 350 K.
